content.text:
The back-to-school flight is finished. It ran Wednesday, July 28 through Saturday, July 31, Central time, and the campaign is now expired.

**Spend:** $449.08 of the $450.00 budget  
**Impressions:** 326,520  
**Link clicks:** 201 (about $2.23 per click)

There is no X pixel on the site, so these are clicks to https://rackwellapp.com/trial, the closest count X can give for trial starts.

|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Wed Jul 28 | $107.11 | 81,205 | 47 |
| Thu Jul 29 | $167.55 | 123,271 | 85 |
| Fri Jul 30 | $159.90 | 101,340 | 63 |
| Sat Jul 31 | $14.53 | 20,704 | 6 |

Ads ran to people 18 and older in the United States, on iPhone, in English. The four posts that link to the trial page were the ones promoted. The door-dumbbell post drew the most clicks (87). After the first day, the workouts and education ad groups were paused because their clicks cost more, and the rest of the budget went to the broad US iPhone ad group.
